## Problem / use case

What are you trying to do, and what's getting in the way? ("I'm trying to … but …")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Scope check

Does this fit the project's scope (local-only, no Play upload, consume-not-capture
screenshots, AOSP frames)? See `CONTRIBUTING.md`. If it crosses a boundary, explain why
it's worth it.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, example configs, links to similar tools.
